en.name: Pomegranate molasses
en.summary: Pomegranate molasses is juice reduced to a dark, sour syrup. A bought bottle keeps about 1–2 years unopened in the cupboard and about 6 months once opened. A home-boiled pomegranate syrup is a different and much weaker product: 1–2 weeks refrigerated, or the freezer.
en.pantry: Unopened, keep the bottle cool and dark for about 1–2 years from purchase; once opened, about 6 months. It is a strongly acidic sugar syrup, which is a hostile environment for microbes — what changes with age is the colour, which darkens towards black, and the flavour, which loses its fruitiness. Cap it tightly and wipe the neck, because a sticky thread down the outside of the bottle attracts mould and ants. Crystals or a thicker pour are normal and not spoilage. Many bottles carry a 'refrigerate after opening' instruction; that is the manufacturer's word and should be followed over the cupboard figure here.
en.fridge: The fridge figure belongs to home-boiled pomegranate syrup, which is far less concentrated than the commercial article: 1–2 weeks refrigerated, or the freezer. Treat that as the limit unless you reduced your syrup all the way to a true molasses. A bought bottle can also live in the fridge if you prefer, or if its label says so; it will pour more slowly when cold, so stand it out for a few minutes before using.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for pomegranate molasses, and a commercial bottle does not need one — it keeps for months in the cupboard on its own. For a home-boiled syrup, the freezer is explicitly offered as the alternative to a short spell in the fridge, and ice-cube trays at −18 °C (0 °F) are the practical format. Thaw a cube or two as you need them rather than the whole batch.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen pomegranate syrup in the fridge, or drop a cube straight into a dressing or a pan. Do not leave it thawing at room temperature.
spoilage: Mould around the neck or cap, usually in sticky residue
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
Fizzing or bubbling in the bottle
A flat, burnt or purely bitter taste with no fruit left — old rather than unsafe
tips: Wipe the neck after every pour; the sticky thread is where trouble starts.
Follow the bottle's own 'refrigerate after opening' instruction if it has one.
Freeze home-boiled syrup in ice-cube trays.
Crystals and a slower pour are normal — warm the bottle gently if you want it looser.

faq.q: Does pomegranate molasses need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: A bought bottle does not for safety — about 6 months in the cupboard once opened — but follow the label if it says to refrigerate. Home-boiled syrup does need the fridge.

faq.q: How long does homemade pomegranate syrup last?
faq.a: 1–2 weeks refrigerated, or freeze it. It is far less concentrated than the commercial bottle.

faq.q: How long does an unopened bottle keep?
faq.a: About 1–2 years in a cool dark cupboard.

faq.q: Why has my pomegranate molasses gone almost black?
faq.a: It darkens with age and loses its fruitiness. That is a quality change, not spoilage.

zh.name: 石榴糖蜜
zh.summary: 石榴糖蜜是把石榴汁收乾成深色酸味糖漿。市售瓶裝未開封放櫥櫃大約 1～2 年，開封後大約 6 個月。自家煮的石榴糖漿則是完全不同、濃度低很多的產品：冷藏 1～2 週，或改用冷凍。
zh.pantry: 未開封請放陰涼避光處，從購買日起算大約 1～2 年；開封後大約 6 個月。它是強酸性的糖漿，對微生物來說是很嚴苛的環境——隨時間改變的是顏色（逐漸轉黑）和風味（果香流失）。請蓋緊並擦淨瓶口，因為瓶身外側那道黏黏的殘液會招來霉和螞蟻。出現結晶或倒起來變稠都是正常的，不是腐壞。許多瓶身會標示「開封後冷藏」；那是製造商的指示，應優先於這裡的櫥櫃數字。
zh.fridge: 冷藏的數字屬於自家煮的石榴糖漿，它的濃度遠低於市售品：冷藏 1～2 週，或改用冷凍。除非你真的把糖漿收到市售糖蜜那樣的濃度，否則就以這個為上限。市售瓶裝當然也可以放冰箱，如果你偏好這樣，或標籤這麼要求的話；只是冷的時候會倒得比較慢，使用前先放著回溫幾分鐘。
zh.freezer: 石榴糖蜜沒有已發表的冷凍期限，市售瓶裝也不需要——它在櫥櫃裡本來就能放好幾個月。自家煮的糖漿則明確被列為「冷藏一小段時間之外的替代選項」，用製冰盒在 −18 °C 凍成小塊最實用。要用時解凍一兩塊就好，不必整批解凍。
zh.thawing: 冷凍的石榴糖漿請放冷藏解凍，或直接把冰塊丟進醬汁或鍋裡。不要放在室溫退冰。
spoilage: 瓶口或瓶蓋周圍在黏漬處長霉
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
喝起來扁平、焦苦、完全沒有果味——那是老了，不是不安全
tips: 每次倒完都擦瓶口；黏漬正是麻煩的起點。
瓶身若標示「開封後冷藏」，請照它的指示。
自家煮的糖漿用製冰盒冷凍。
結晶和倒得較慢是正常的——想要稀一點可以隔水微微加溫。

faq.a: 市售瓶裝以安全而言不用——開封後在櫥櫃大約 6 個月——但標籤要求冷藏就照做。自家煮的糖漿則一定要冷藏。

faq.q: 自製石榴糖漿可以放多久？
faq.a: 冷藏 1～2 週，或改用冷凍。它的濃度比市售瓶裝低很多。

faq.q: 未開封的石榴糖蜜可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 1～2 年。

faq.q: 石榴糖蜜為什麼幾乎變黑了？
faq.a: 它會隨時間變深、果香流失。那是品質變化，不是腐壞。
